title: HEAL AND PLATE LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps callout, never a sentence. The review of the sixth batch of raid text found the heal and plate lines still written as sentences. At full health the heal verb said Already at full, with only Bandages above their reach it said a whole sentence about 85 and a Medkit, and a plate landing said Armour Plate slotted. Armour 60. They now read HEALTH FULL, ALREADY HEALING, BANDAGES STOP AT 85 (the number read from the Bandage ceiling) with You need a Medkit. as the detail, NO MEDICAL SUPPLIES, ALREADY APPLYING and ARMOUR PLATE SLOTTED with the armour as the detail. Patching up a teammate says SELECT A HEAL, MOTH ARMOUR FULL, MOTH DOES NOT NEED IT, ALREADY SLOTTING and NO BANDAGE LEFT. No rule moved: the same refusals fire at the same moments.
now: The heal and plate refusals read as short caps callouts, such as HEALTH FULL and BANDAGES STOP AT 85.
